newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST - Reuters foreign exchange poll - March.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Reuters foreign exchange poll - March.

text.p: The dollar's current level against the mark is seen to be the highest it will reach for the next 12 months, according to an average of forecasts in a Reuter poll of 34 banks and financial institutions from across the globe.
The US currency is expected to weaken during the next month to trade at 1.7047 marks before continuing the trend lower to trade at 1.6615 a year from now.
The highest the dollar is expected to climb is to 1.8300 marks during this time while the lowest it is predicted to fall is to 1.5000 marks.

At 0844 GMT, the dollar was trading at 1.7173/78 marks and 121.53/58 yen. Sterling/dollar was quoted at $1.6111/23, sterling/mark at 2.7680/90 and mark/yen at 70.74/77.
The minimum and maximum forecasts were as follows --

Against the yen, the dollar is expected to stay close to current levels during the next month before slipping to 121.34 in three months time. It is then expected to continue its progress downwards to trade at 120.85 in six months before falling further to trade at 117.74 in a year from now.
The lowest dollar/yen is expected to trade during the next year is 105.00.

On the other hand, sterling is expected to firm slightly over the next month, to trade at 1.6129, continuing to climb further to trade at 1.6152 in three months from now. Cable is then expected to weaken falling to trade at $1.6057 in six months before a slight correction is made, in a year from now forecasters expect cable to be trading at $1.6072.
The lowest level sterling is expected to fall to during the next 12 months is $1.5000, the highest it is expected to climb to is $1.7500.
The rankings of the 34 forecaster polled, on March 4 and 5, by the accuracy of their one-month predictions will be published in the first week of April, just before the results of the next poll.
